entries.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
entries.answer: Cover the standalone public QIF repository's world-model-calibration package, schema, verifier, examples, readiness CLI, fixtures, authoring guidance, roadmap, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub Release. Stay out of scope: UI, external integrations, production pilot data, automatic acceptance of evaluator recommendations, semantic-truth claims, and calibration-report statistics.

entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success means an implemented Framework Learning Record can satisfy CRD-LEARNING only when contradictory empirical evidence, accepted accountable governance, implemented artifact references, validation evidence, rollback criteria, and resolved governance triggers are structurally present; proposed, example-only, ungoverned, or unvalidated changes remain blocked; npm test and AOF verification pass; v0.6.30 is published.
